project.name: Project Name
project.outcome: State the observable world-change this project exists to produce.

source_authority.scope: Project purpose, authority, and terminal state

hierarchy.label: Milestone 1
hierarchy.purpose: Deliver the first verifiable project state.

current.purpose_connection: This proposed first unit would create the first verifiable state needed by the project outcome.
current.next_action: Confirm the charter, completion contract, and authority before starting execution.

may: Prepare and validate this project-control proposal
may_not: Begin project execution or take irreversible external action without separate authority
grants.rationale: Preserve owner control over consequential actions.
grants.revisit_trigger: The owner changes scope or terminal state.

reserved: External publication, spend, and irreversible production changes

work_packages.outcome: Produce the first verifiable project state.

exit_criteria.description: The milestone outcome is demonstrated by the named evidence method.

completion_contract.definition: M1 is done only when the required states below are satisfied or explicitly waived by an authorized decision.

controls.description: The first commitment is small enough to complete under current capacity.
controls.trigger: The commitment exceeds the current control interval.
controls.next_action: Validate by decomposing and checking capacity.
controls.objective: Protect the first commitment from capacity failure.
controls.cause_event_effect: Because capacity is unverified, an oversized commitment may exceed the control interval and delay the first evidence-bearing outcome.
controls.exposure: Schedule, flow, and confidence exposure are unknown until capacity is checked.
controls.treatment: Decompose the work and compare demand with available capacity before authorization.
controls.resource_commitment: Project lead time for one capacity review.
controls.residual_state: Residual uncertainty remains until real throughput is observed.
controls.escalation_threshold: Escalate if the first commitment exceeds the control interval or WIP limit.

remaining: Replace template values and validate the first commitment.
checkpoints.next_action: Create the first evidence-bearing work package.

justification.reason: State why this project is the best authorized intervention for the intended outcome.
alternatives: Describe the credible do-nothing or lower-cost alternative.
justification.viability: Record the evidence and constraints that make the project viable or doubtful.
justification.revisit_trigger: Material change to value, viability, cost, risk, or strategic fit.

benefits.outcome: Describe the measurable benefit expected after operational transition.
benefits.measure: Name the measure and collection method.
benefits.baseline: Record the current state or state that it is unknown.
benefits.target: Record the intended target and horizon.
benefits.review_at: After operational transition at the agreed benefit horizon.

governance.cadence: Review at each control interval and exception trigger.
tolerances: Escalate forecast, benefit, risk, quality, or capacity exceptions beyond agreed limits.

gates.authority: Project sponsor or delegated decision owner

governance.decision_latency_target: Record the maximum decision age before escalation.

forecast.basis: Provisional range pending decomposition, dependency, and capacity evidence.
forecast.variance: Not applicable until a baseline is approved.
forecast.next_update: After the first work-package and capacity review.

constraints: Confirm actual people, time, specialist, environment, and decision capacity.
capacity.bottleneck: Unknown until flow and dependency review.
capacity.next_action: Validate capacity and the bottleneck before authorizing concurrent work.

stakeholders.incentive: Clarify the outcome, risk, and decision incentive.
stakeholders.evidence: No direct stakeholder evidence recorded yet.
stakeholders.next_move: Confirm sponsorship, decision rights, and readiness.

transition.benefit_review_at: At the agreed post-transition benefit horizon.
residuals: Confirm operational ownership, support readiness, and benefit-review timing.
